title: Tannenstraße, Düsseldorf
description:
This unique 1.5-room flat with 54 square metres is located on the grounds of the former Ulanen barracks in Düsseldorf-Derendorf.
The house was built during the Wilhelminian period and was used for military purposes in the first decades. The entire campus is a listed building. A spacious staircase welcomes you. The flat is located on the 2nd floor. The ambience is characterised by the approx. 3.60m high ceilings, the open living-dining area, as well as the view into the green inner courtyard (balcony with seating area).
The furnishing of this flat follows the "Eames x Girard" principle. The designer Alexandre Girard further developed the now very well-known Plastic Chairs by Charles & Ray Eames for the furnishing of the restaurant "La Fonda del Sol" in 1961. Two such chairs stand as vintag(hidden)ssics at the dining table. The entire design was put together by the interior designer in a warm Scandinavian style around the design language of Eames and Girard. Thus, in the spirit of these two designers, designs by Jaime Hayon, Verner Panton and Anders Pehrson can also be found in the object. Attention has been paid to every detail. 
Fast internet is included (50 Mbit), washing machine and dryer are in (hidden)ment. A parking space in the underground garage can be rented optionally (120 euros per month). Regular cleaning is included. Sustainability is important to the landlords - electricity and heating are therefore 100% "green".
Restaurants, small shops, bus and tram stops are within walking distance. Large companies are also located in the immediate vicinity (including L'Oreal, Deloitte, Rheinmetall, Mediacom, Grey, PwC. The airport is 6-8 minutes away by car, the Rhine can be reached in 10 minutes on foot, the city centre in 10 minutes by tram/15 minutes by bike. Despite the location "right in the middle", you don't hear the noise and hustle and bustle of the city in the flat.
Newly renovated 2022
Parking space, fast WLAN, simply everything included
Cleaning service every 2 weeks included 
Tenant will have to pay broadcasting fee (GEZ) if registered as residence address ("Vermieterbescheinigung" possible)
